title: Remove the web-URL, shell-word and SHA-1 helpers from core's susi-paths
goal: Vision: V-9. CEO direction 2026-11-18: core under 25,000 lines; Tier 3 starts with the file-paths crate. susi-paths' weburl, shlex and sha1 modules have no caller in core; every user is in Susi Commercial Apps. Once Commercial Apps owns them with their tests (T-CLAUDEPATHS-1), delete core's copies and the SHA-1 compatibility test, and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING to the new measure.

reuse.searched: Core's susi-paths modules and Susi Commercial Apps' new susi-paths-extras. Delete-only: no new code and no dependency.
